headline: Soledad health care district is back with monthly mammograms, and looking to fill spots.
summary: The City of Soledad recognized October as Breast Cancer Awareness Month with a resolution approved by the City Council on Wednesday, Oct. 7.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
